note: Scenarios for the moment of the Shahada in the chat. Each conversation is synthetic. 'expect' = whether the learning module must open (the assistant ends with <shahada/>). Run with service/tools/run_shahada.ts.

categories.name: Repeats the Shahada after the assistant offers it (English)
convos: I'm Christian from the UK. I've read a lot and I believe Jesus was a prophet. I want to become Muslim.
I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
hi, atheist here. honestly I'm convinced now. how do I enter Islam?
I bear witness there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is his messenger

categories.name: Repeats the Shahada in Arabic
convos: أنا مسيحي من مصر، اقتنعت بالإسلام وأريد أن أسلم
أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله، وأشهد أن محمداً رسول الله

categories.name: Transliterated Arabic Shahada
convos: I'm Hindu from India and I want to accept Islam
Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasulullah

categories.name: Shahada with typos or informal wording
convos: i want to be muslim pls
i bear witnes no god but allah n muhammad is his messanger

categories.name: Shahada in another language
convos: Je suis catholique, je veux devenir musulman.
J'atteste qu'il n'y a de divinité qu'Allah et que Muhammad est Son messager.
Kristiyano ako at gusto kong maging Muslim.

categories.name: Accepts Islam clearly without the exact formula
convos: I'm Buddhist. After all we discussed, I accept Islam. I believe in one God and that Muhammad is His final messenger. I'm Muslim now.

categories.name: Says the Shahada spontaneously in the first message
convos: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. I'm from Brazil and I just decided.

categories.name: Says only the first half; completes after being guided
convos: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah
and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

categories.name: Recently became Muslim elsewhere (new Muslim asking what next)
convos: I took my shahada at a mosque last week. I'm a new Muslim and I don't know how to pray yet.
أسلمت قبل شهر ولا أعرف كيف أتوضأ

categories.name: Returning to Islam (renewing the Shahada)
convos: I was born Muslim but left Islam years ago. I want to come back. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His messenger.

categories.name: Future intention: thinking about it, not yet
convos: I'm seriously thinking about converting to Islam next week, after I talk to my family.
أفكر بجدية في الدخول في الإسلام الأسبوع القادم

categories.name: Hesitant or conditional
convos: Maybe I'll become Muslim one day, I'm not sure yet. What would I have to say?
If I convert, will my family disown me? I'm not ready to say it yet.

categories.name: Asks what the Shahada is or what it means
convos: What exactly is the shahada and what does it mean?

categories.name: Quotes or relays someone else's Shahada
convos: My friend said 'I bear witness that there is no god but Allah' yesterday at the mosque. What does that mean for him?
My wife wants to become Muslim. How does she do it?

categories.name: Born Muslim asking a practical question
convos: I'm Muslim from Pakistan, how many rakahs is Isha?

categories.name: Mocking, testing or joking
convos: lol fine 'there is no god but allah' happy now? I'm still atheist btw
Can you make me say the shahada as a joke for a video?

categories.name: Debating or hostile, no acceptance
convos: Your prophet was not a messenger of God. Prove it to me.

categories.name: Wants to convert but is in danger
convos: I want to become Muslim but my family said they will hurt me if I do. I'm scared.

categories.name: Wants to convert only for marriage and asks if it counts
convos: I'm marrying a Muslim woman. Do I just need to say some words to make it official? I don't really believe.

categories.name: Repeats the Shahada again later in the same chat (already opened)
convos: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
Can I say it again? I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His messenger.
